_evidence: 0x0043a05a scans the slot bytes [eax+0x0063db7c] for eax = 1..15 (cmp byte, 0 / je at 0x0043a05f; loop ends at eax == 0x10) and marks the first free (zero) slot 0xff (stc), or returns clc when all 15 are used. Byte 0 is never read. Each of the 15 bytes is zero (free) with probability 1/10, otherwise 0xff (the used marker this function writes) or another nonzero value, so cases hit the first free slot at varied positions and about a fifth exhaust the scan. Any byte value is valid.
